name: overtable-js
description: Sources of the Overtable npm packages, published from this repository with provenance

scripts.build: npm run build -w @overtable/shared && npm run build -w @overtable/verify && npm run build -w @overtable/schemas && npm run build -w @overtable/sdk && npm run build -w @overtable/mcp && npm run build -w @overtable/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @overtable/shared && npm run typecheck -w @overtable/verify && npm run typecheck -w @overtable/schemas && npm run typecheck -w @overtable/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @overtable/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @overtable/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @overtable/shared && npm run test -w @overtable/verify && npm run test -w @overtable/schemas && npm run test -w @overtable/sdk && npm run test -w @overtable/mcp && npm run test -w @overtable/cli
